title: 2027 Newell Brands Intern – Brand Design
note: Packaging and digital brand graphics in Newell's 12-week CAMP intern program; needs a 3.0 GPA and junior or senior standing.

facts.summary: Twelve-week paid summer internship on Newell Brands' Brand Design team, part of the CAMP intern program.
facts.duties: Helps with packaging graphics, dielines, mockups and print-ready files, makes e-commerce, social and email graphics, keeps work on brand, and leads a CAMP project presented to leaders.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's student in graphic or communication design who has finished junior or senior year, GPA 3.0+, Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign, basic packaging and print knowledge, and a portfolio; Figma or After Effects a plus.
facts.apply: Apply online through the Newell Brands careers site with a portfolio.
